data_description: Fictional shopping preferences and 17 invented orders spanning 2016–2026, authored solely for README illustration. Synthetic service/source cards demonstrate non-photographic media. No actual account, order export, purchase amount or private photograph is used.

product_images.purpose: Fictional product props for the README showcase only, not purchase evidence or platform images.
product_images.prompt_template: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE photorealistic studio product photograph for a clearly fictional shopping-journal README demonstration. Subject: {subject} Centered three-quarter view, off-white seamless background, subtle realistic contact shadow, natural side daylight, refined e-commerce editorial photography, realistic fabric/material texture, ample clean margin, square composition. No people, no private content, no brand, no logo, no watermark, no prices, no text or captions. This is fictional illustration only, not a real platform purchase or receipt.
subjects: An original unbranded small sage-green ceramic desk lamp with a cream linen shade, switched on, warm light.
An original unbranded green-and-cream checkerboard crochet shoulder bag with a simple green strap, complete bag.
An original unbranded warm taupe upholstered dining/desk chair with rounded backrest and walnut wood legs, complete chair.
An original unbranded pale-yellow tiny pet vest with simple lavender daisy motifs, neatly laid out, no animal present.

runtime_rule: Real journal projects must use images from the actual order, the verified matching product page/specification, or authorized photographs of that same product. Never substitute generated or similar products for order evidence.
capture_note: Current preview-*.png captures are from the verified local paper-keepsake preview. The older JPGs and share.png remain as historical design resources and are not current UI screenshots. No capture demonstrates real-account collection or a complete live-platform test.
